scope: monthly U.S. stock headline-strategy transfer using JKP
portfolio_adapter_rule: Use the common wrapper for score-only methods. Preserve an explicitly central native portfolio policy where feasible; fix and report exposure/risk-budget adaptations before returns rather than silently replacing it.
benchmark_source: existing corrected U.S. factor panels and retained benchmark ladder; identities, hashes, and realization clock must be validated before freeze
learning_rule: Initial fitting, candidate search and any tuning use earlier outcomes only; record a chronological fixed or rolling policy for each learned strategy. No tuning on its common evaluation results.
calendar_rule: Use the fixed calendar and report missing coverage/path failures. Do not silently drop unfavorable months or use strategy-specific calendars in the common headline comparison.
multiplicity_rule: One primary prespecified strategy test per paper; preserve non-evaluable outcomes as missing performance, not zero returns. Use the declared conservative family correction for evaluable claims.
publication_rule: Keep licensed security-level data, scores and holdings in approved non-public storage; publish code, manifests and permitted aggregate results only.
